matrix.required: Missing or empty attachments and persisted v1 original-key replay retain original template1/digest/receipt. Never globally upgrade conversation/project.

matrix.case: new v2 page → old page GET/history/queue
matrix.required: Old page can display text/control queue but does not show attachments; explicitly limited compatibility, not full material UI.
Missing/false attachment capability blocks nonempty attachments; plain request omits attachments entirely, because old strictObject rejects even []. No silent material downgrade.
Nonempty attachments uses template2 and shared F01 decoder ordered identity guard; old v1 remains intact. Malicious v2 ACK to old v1 request remains unknown with original key/body.

noNewProtocol: No Accept/header/GET blocking or field stripping/digest alteration is introduced without an actual incompatible reader. Existing queue blocked reason closed enum is preserved.
